book.name: Luk
book.title: Toto Thovuye Utuniye Luk Le Rorori

content: Jisas le virɨ utuutuniye
Va e mbaŋaŋgiko thiyako Sisa Ogastas i worawe le mbaro na thɨ wo vavaona Rom ele ghamba mbaro tɨne.
Vavaonako iyako ambama thɨ wokai vara mbaŋa Koniliyos ghambaŋa gawana Siriya e tɨne.
Taulaghɨko va thɨ raka, regha na regha vambe i wa e vanarɨghe moli na ve roriya idaewe.
Josep i ri Nasaret Galili e tɨne na i wa Betɨlehem Judiya e tɨne. Ghembako iyako Deivid vanarɨghe na Josep va i wawe kaiwae iye Deivid rumbuye.
Josep va ve rorinjoŋa idae weiye Meri, iye vama ghadagerawe weiye Meri vama ghanono ghambɨ.
Na mbaŋa va inanji gheko, Meri ghambaŋa i ghamba nariyeko.
I ghambɨkai vara nariye ŋgama ghɨmoru, i ghavo riwae e kwama na i worawe kau e lenji ghamba ghanɨŋga, kaiwae ma vama ŋgolo bobwari regha kokowae ina gheko kaiwanji.
Nyao thovuye i giya sip gharanjimbunjimbu yanawanji
E valɨvaŋgako iyako sip gharanjimbunjimbu vavana va inanjiwe e ghembako valɨvaŋga regha, thɨ njimbukikiŋgiya lenji sip gougou.
Giya le nyao thovuye regha i yomara weŋgi, amba Giya le vwenyevwenye manjamanjalawae i vakeke vaghɨliyaŋgi na thɨ mararu laghɨye moli.
Ko iyemaeŋge nyaoko thovuye i dage weŋgi iŋa, “Thava hu mararu! Wo hu thuwe, ya womena warari laghɨye na wararike iyake ne i womena warari laghɨye weŋgiya gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye.
E gougouke noroke, Deivid e ghambae ghami Ravamoru i virɨ, iye Mesaiya na Giya.
Ghanono ŋgoreiyake weŋga: Ne hu thuwe ŋgama gunagunagha regha thɨ ghavo riwae e kwama na i ghena kau e lenji ghamba ghanɨŋga.”
E mbaŋako iyako rameburuburu lemoyo moli thɨ yomara na thɨ tataraweŋa Loi weinji nyaoma thovuye thɨŋa,

content.text: “Wovavwenyevwenye i voro weya Loi, iye i mevoro moli e buruburu,
na e yambaneke Loi le gharemalɨlɨ weŋgiya gharɨgharɨ amalaghɨniye i warariŋaŋgi.”

content: Mbaŋa vama nyaoma thovuthovuye thɨ rakaiteteŋgi na thɨ rakanjogha e buruburu, sipɨma gharanjimbunjimbu thɨ vedage weŋgi thɨŋa, “Ra raka Betɨlehem na wo vara thuwe bigike iya me yomarake, iya Giya me utugiya utuniyeke weinda.”
Vambema ghenji na nɨmanji eŋge vethɨ tamwe vaidiya Meri na Josep na ŋgamama nasiye i ghena kau e lenji ghamba ghanɨŋga.
Mbaŋa thɨ thuwe ŋgamama tembe thɨ vathigiyava weŋgi budakaiya nyaoma thovuthovuye lenji woraŋgiya weŋgi ŋgamako utuniye.
Thavala va thɨ loŋwe sipɨko gharanjimbunjimbu lenji utu gharenji i yo laghɨye,
ko iyemaeŋge Meri ghare i thalavwayaŋa bigibigike thiyake kaiwanji na i worawe e ghare.
Sip gharanjimbunjimbu thɨ rakanjogha, thɨ wovavwenyevwenyeŋa na thɨ taraweŋa Loi, lenji loŋwe na lenji thuweko kaiwae, ŋgoreiya nyao thovuye le woraŋgiya weŋgi.
Thɨ rena idae
Mbaŋa theghewaniye e tɨne, kaero valɨkaiwae na thɨ kitena ŋgamako riwae njimwae, thɨ rena idae Jisas, ŋgoreiya nyao thovuye va le woraŋgiya weya Meri mbaŋa ma vamba i marabo.
Meri na Josep thɨ yowo Jisas e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne
Mbaŋa vama Josep na Meri ghanjimbaŋa thɨ vakatha riwanji i thɨna ŋgoreiya Mosese le Mbaro i woraŋgiya, thɨ wo ŋgamama na weinji thɨ voro Jerusalem na thɨ vatomwe weya Giya,
ŋgoreiya Giya le mbaro thɨ rori Buk Boboma e tɨne iŋa, “Gamau ghɨmoghɨmoruna wolaghɨye hu vabobomaŋgi weya Giya.”
Tembe ŋgoreiyeva thɨ mbana bunebune manyiwo o mbo manyiwo na thɨ vowowe ŋgoreiya Giya le mbaro i woraŋgiya.
Amala regha va ina Jerusalem idae Simiyon. Iye va i rumwaru na i ghambugha Loi. Nyao Boboma va inawe. Vambe i roroghagha vara thembaŋa Isirel gharɨgharɨniye thɨ vaidiya vamoru.
Nyaoko Boboma le woraŋgiyawe, mamba ne i vaidiya ghakula ghaghada i thuwe Ravamoru iye Loi va i dagerawe.
Ŋgoreiya Nyao Boboma le woraŋgiyawe, Simiyon ve ru e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne, na mbaŋa Josep na Meri thɨ woruwo ŋgamako Jisas na thɨ vakathawe ŋgoreiya ghanjithanavu na lenji mbaro le woraŋgiya weŋgi,
Simiyon i wo ŋgamako na i worawe e nɨmanɨmae amba i tarawe Loi iŋa,

content.text: “O Giya Laghɨye, kaero ŋgoreiya len dagerawema, e mbaŋake iyake u vatomweya len rakakaiwo na i garalawa weiye gharemalɨlɨ,
kaiwae e maraŋguke kaero ya thuwe len vamoru,
va u vivatharawe gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye e maranji.
Iye manjamanjala na ne i woya weŋgiya thiye ma Jiu, na ne i vavwenyevwenyaŋgiya len gharɨgharɨ Isirel.”

content: Ŋgamako ramae na tɨnae thɨ ndetaele budakaiya Simiyon va i utuŋa ŋgamako kaiwae.

Amba Simiyon i naŋgo weya Loi na ghare weŋgi na i dage weya Meri iŋa, “Ŋgamake iyake gharerenuwaŋa ŋgoreiya ne i vakathaŋgiya gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ dobu na gharɨgharɨ lemoyo thɨ yondovirɨ Isirel e tɨne. Iye ne nono i mena weya Loi na gharɨgharɨ lemoyo ne thɨ utuvatharɨwe,
na amalaghɨniye kaiwae gharɨgharɨ lemoyo lenji renuwaŋa thuwele ne thɨ rakaraŋgi e manjamanjala. Ne vɨrɨ ghamɨnae ŋgoreiya gaithɨ ghaghalithɨ ne i vweya gharena.”
Yalaghɨsarɨ eunda idae Ana, Penuwel yawarumbuye na i mena Asa e gheuu tɨne. Iye Loi ghalɨŋae gharautu. Le ghe e ghereiye, theghathegha vambe umbopirɨ eŋge i yaku weiye le ghɨmoru
kaero i wambwiva ghaghada mbaŋako iyako ghatheghathegha kaero i wo ghwewa na umbovarɨ. Ma mbaŋa regha i iteta Ŋgolo Boboma, ghararaghɨye na gougou i kururu weya Loi, i mbeya ghanɨŋga na i naŋgonaŋgo.
Va e mbaŋako iyako i vuthawe, i vata ago weya Loi na i utuŋa ŋgamako utuutuniye weŋgiya gharɨgharɨke wolaghɨye thiye va thɨ roroghagha thembaŋa Loi ne i unuyathu Jerusalem e vuyowo tɨne.
Mbaŋa Josep na Meri thɨ vakathavao bigibigiko wolaghɨye ŋgoreiya Giya le Mbaro gharerenuwaŋa, kaero thɨ njoghava e ghambanji, Nasaret, Galili e tɨne.
Ŋgamako i tabo na laghɨye na i vurɨgheghe, thimba i riyevanjara na Loi le gharemwaewo inawe.
Ghatheghathegha hoyaworo na umboiwo Jisas kaero ve ru e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne
Theghathagha regha na regha e tɨne tɨnae na ramae thɨ wawa Jerusalem Thaga Valaŋani kaiwae.
Mbaŋa vama ghatheghathegha hoyaworo na umboiwo, tembe thɨ wava ŋgoreiye thɨ vakavakathama.
Thaga e ghereiye, tɨnae na ramae thɨ wareriŋa ghambanji, ko iyemaeŋge Jisas vambe ina Jerusalem. Tɨnae na ramae mava thɨ ghareghare iyako.
Lenji renuwaŋa thɨŋa eŋge vama weinji. Mbaŋako iyako yeghɨyeghɨyeniye amba thɨ tamwe. Thɨ tamwe weŋgiya lenji bodaboda na ghanjiune vavana.
Ko iyemaeŋge ma thɨ vaidi, iya kaiwae tembe thɨ njoghava Jerusalem na vethɨ tamwewe.
Mbaŋa thegheto e ghereiye amba thɨ vaidi e Ŋgolo Boboma tɨne weiyaŋgiya mbaro gharavavaghare vavana i vandeŋeŋgi na i giyagiya vaito weŋgi.
Taulaghɨko gharenji i yo le ghareghare na le gonjoghako kaiwae.
Tɨnae na ramae gharenji i yo mbaŋa thɨ vaidi. Tɨnae i dagewe iŋa, “Naruŋgu, buda kaiwae u vakatha weime ŋgorako? Ghino na rama wo rerenuwaŋa laghɨye kaiwan, wo tamwetamwe e ghen.”
I dage weŋgi iŋa, “Buda kaiwae hu tamwetamwe weŋgo? Ma hu ghareghare valɨkaiwae inaŋgu bwebwe ele ŋgolo?”
Ko iyemaeŋge ma nuwanji i manjamanjala ŋgoroŋga meŋako weŋgi.
Amba i wa weiyaŋgi, thɨ njogha Nasaret na i ghambugha ghalɨŋanji. Ko tɨnae vambe i renuwaŋakiki vara bigibigiko thiyako na i worawe e ghare.
Jisas i tabo na laghɨye, i thimba na i vakatha Loi i warari kaiwae na tembe ŋgoreiye thavala thɨ ghareghare.
